 - All-round Employee (full-time) with training to become a wind instrument repair technician 
Magna Music in Roosendaal is looking for an enthusiastic all-round employee with a passion for wind instruments. Would you like to learn the craft of repairing woodwind and brass instruments? Then this is your chance! What will you do? 
As an all-round employee at Magna Music you are involved in all aspects of our store: from advising customers and selling instruments to organising workshops and supporting colleagues in other departments. At the same time you will start an internal training programme to become a wind instrument repair technician, guided by experienced craftspeople and masterclasses with top brands abroad. What are we looking for? - You play a brass or woodwind instrument, or are willing to learn. - You have a passion for music and a curious, eager-to-learn attitude. - You are flexible, customer-oriented and enjoy working in a small team. - You speak fluent Dutch and have a good command of English. - You are willing to work on Saturdays as well. What do we offer? - A varied role in a brand-new music store with a wide range of products. - An intensive training programme to become a repair technician, including international masterclasses. - An enthusiastic team where everyone pitches in and supports each other. - A competitive salary and attractive secondary employment conditions. - Growth opportunities within a growing organisation. 
Can you picture yourself as part of our team and learning the trade of repair technician? Send your CV and cover letter to Erwin@magnamusic.nl. For questions you can contact Erwin Eestermans at +31 (0)165 54 58 24.

jobs.description:
About UsDe Pijp Boutique Hotel is a premium, intimate design hotel located in the heart of Amsterdam's most vibrant neighborhood. Because we are a small boutique property with a close-knit team, our night staff plays a crucial role in maintaining high-end guest satisfaction, safety, and operational excellence while the city sleeps.We are looking for a reliable, responsible, and proactive Part-Time Night Receptionist who takes pride in absolute ownership of the property during the night.Position SummaryAs our Night Receptionist, you are the sole guardian of the hotel during the late-night and early-morning hours (typically from 00:00 to 08:00). You will manage late arrivals, early departures, safety checks, and basic food and beverage preparation for the morning. This role requires high autonomy, a sharp eye for detail, and an absolute commitment to maintaining our premium boutique standards.
